integrity: The source/sink cut description is compatible with established full-root abelian-set classifications and is not claimed as a new full-root classification. The asserted contribution is the integral positive-root incidence kernel and Smith factors, Walsh cutoff, sharp reconstruction boundary, and the accompanying exact enumerator. Finite tests do not replace the uniform proof. Independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only root-vector cliques in the positive strictly upper-triangular type-A nilradical are treated; no classification of arbitrary maximal abelian subalgebras. The rational Gram assertion is not asserted after modular reduction. Exact proof is general n>=2; exhaustive maximal-clique computer checks stop at n=6, rank and kernel checks at n=9. Some plausible older full texts were inaccessible and literature priority is not exhaustively certified.
title: Quadratic Walsh cutoff for maximal type-A root-commuting incidence
